notes: Seven www.mews.com pages read (pricing, home, PMS, channel manager, payments, guest check-in, Introducing Mews OS), all HTTP 200 and not thin. Two help.mews.com articles cited by the answers (Portfolio pricing plan, contract FAQs) rendered no text on the fetch (script-rendered, thin); in pass 2 they and the channel manager help article were each read once in a real browser. Plan naming is the main open issue: the pricing page read on 8 Oct lists Mews Core, Mews Pro and Enterprise, while the help center read the same day still documents Portfolio and Brand plans and links Essentials and Advanced plan articles by title. The Introducing Mews OS page carries no date in its text, so no dated plan change could be established and nothing is coded stale. C27 (335+ integrations) is true only as a lower bound of the published 1,000+. Awards (HotelTechAwards), ratings, market-position lines, the 35 percent RMS accuracy claim, feature names such as DataChat, Guest CRM and Native Email Marketing, and hedged cost lines were not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): C05 (contract FAQ fees), C08 (Portfolio and Brand plans), C09 (Brand includes Open API and unlimited Marketplace), C10 (API access depends on plan) and C16 (Core covers three default OTAs) unverifiable to true from the browser snapshots; C11 stays unverifiable because the Portfolio feature lists did not render; C12 to C15 stay unverifiable. The gap lines and the tables and vendor sub-headings held no further in-scope statement about Mews (the ~190 versus 335+ table cells are already C27 instances; q5 Claude answers that price Mews are not in this vendor's deposit set). No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes.
